purpose: Specify and test bounded Stage 0 offspring mutation selection and lineage replacement decisions after runtime lifecycle/archive parent selection, without claiming persistent profile-weighted evolution.

external_anchors.source: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites
external_anchors.used_for: Lineage replacement is evaluated against archive niches instead of scalar top-k alone.
Offspring mutation and replacement are treated as evolutionary operators that need explicit gates.

external_anchors.source: Introduction to Evolutionary Computing online accompaniment
external_anchors.used_for: Survivor selection and replacement are kept separate from parent selection.

limitations: Preview only: no grid cells are changed.
Preview only: does not prove offspring validity or archive impact.

mutation_gate.selection_rule: rank by bounded offspring score over survival, need balance, bond, archive fitness, novelty, parent continuity, cap compliance, validity, and SLIP alignment

lineage_decision.reason: parent remains elite until child beats replacement threshold

profile_results.closed_policy_boundary: Stage 0 selects bounded offspring and emits a lineage decision; it still does not run persistent multigeneration evolution.
